events.title: ZOOT IS ON FIRE! — Alpha Demo v0.18.0
events.summary: Hey everyone!Matchy Star Alpha Demo v0.18.0 is live! This update is all about making BLASTOFF faster, clearer, and much more satisfying.Blastoff now follows one simple rule: the rocket keeps moving. Movement, turns, collection effects, sounds, and rumble remain synchronized as the ship accelerates. Matches caught during launch resolve without stalling the run, while major reward popups linger long enough to celebrate—even after the rocket has flown past them.There’s also a new live ZOOT COUNTER!

events.title: The 5-Planet Run Update Is Here!
events.summary: Hey everyone!I just pushed a major new build of Matchy Star, and this is a big step toward the game I’ve been trying to make.The headline feature is the new 5-planet run structure. Instead of feeling like a set of loose levels, Matchy Star is starting to feel much more like a real run-based space adventure. You’ll travel from planet to planet, build up your strategy, and see how far your current setup can take you.This update also adds a new camera perspective, which gives the board and world a

events.title: Matchy Gets Vertical
events.summary: Ever wanted to play on your vertical monitor? Or how about switching to windowed mode and resizing the game? Now you can! We also fixed a bug with loading and saving item stats on computers based in countries that use a decimal point the way the USA uses a comma. Hit me up if you want to demo the game, we are shooting for March 31 for a totally revamped version of the game that is 100 times more fun.

events.title: Speed, Progression, and Item Strategy Redesign
events.summary: Matchy is not dead! We've gotten a bunch of detailed critique and are starting another round of development. New things to come in the next build: 150 unique items - Instead of having a million versions of a top hat with slightly different stats that don't make much difference, each item will be unique, affecting the game in it's own way. events.title: Matchy with your Joystick!
events.summary: Big change: Joystick support. Tons of small fixes: No longer possible to get cash onto the ships. Green buttons have green text. Shop and Overworld music cannot play at once. Improve win confetti particle. Back button works correctly. Selecting locked planet shakes planet.

events.title: Our new game network SWGIO.COM
events.summary: We've had a lot of trouble getting seen on steam. They seem to push us to the back and not let us get much visibility. So we've created our own gaming network that lets you play games on your phone without downloading them, compete with others directly or for high score, co op, and post social posts.
